info.description: Reusable item for a card, FAQ, about highlight, link, or consultation. Fill only fields used by that section.

title.description: Card heading, FAQ question, link label, or consultation name.

number.description: Optional visible number for pillar cards, for example 01 or A1.

description.description: Card copy, FAQ answer, link destination for navigation items, or consultation summary.

body.description: Optional longer formatted copy when the section supports it.

label.description: Optional short label displayed above or beside the value.

value.description: Optional short value, such as a statistic or contact detail.

url.description: Optional destination URL for a card or link.

consultationId.description: Booking identifier; used only for pricing consultation cards.

fee.description: Consultation fee as a number; use feeLabel when there is no fixed fee.

feeLabel.description: Display instead of a fixed fee, for example Complimentary or By enquiry.

bookable.description: Whether the visitor can book this consultation online.

paymentLink.description: Optional secure payment URL for this consultation.

colour.description: Pricing card theme key, such as gold, navy, ink, or accent.

buttonText.description: Optional label for a pricing card action button.

buttonUrl.description: Optional destination for a pricing card action button.
